bio.text: Sam Sutton represents New York State Senate District 22 in Brooklyn, covering Midwood, Flatbush, Borough Park, Marine Park, Gerritsen Beach and Sheepshead Bay; he won a May 20, 2025 special election to fill the seat vacated by Simcha Felder and was sworn in later that month.
According to Ballotpedia, he is running for re-election and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
BK Reader describes him as a Brooklyn native and long-time nonprofit executive and Sephardic community activist.
VINnews reports that he served three decades with Sephardic Bikur Holim and has worked with the Sephardic Community Federation, the Safe Foundation and NYU Langone Medical Center.
